comparison.objective: Register a block against two perpendicular fixture stops; candidate commissions and locks an adjustable shock absorber through dynamic trials.
comparison.physical_skill: Block handoff, planar placement and two-face registration versus hex-key engagement, collar adjustment, bounded tightening and response-based iteration.
comparison.success_condition: Requires ≤1 mm gaps, ≤2° squareness and stable flat placement; candidate requires two safe ≥0.85 J cycles, ≤12 mm travel, no hard-stop strike/rebound/overload and verified lock retention.
comparison.reason: Both involve precision, but they test different contact mechanics, manipulation sequences and outcomes.
